subject: OPERATOR REVIEW: scraper snapshot found inside .git (possible past exposure)
description: Found during marathon 2026-07-09: ~250 index.html directory-listing snapshots dated Jan 8 were sitting INSIDE .git/ (every objects/ fan-out dir, logs/, hooks/, etc.), titled 'Directory listing for /Ai content creation/Hexworth Prime/.git/...' — i.e. some HTTP server once served the repo's OLD location with directory listings on, and a crawler saved its own output back into the tree, including the full .git internals. All archived to _archive/git-stray-2026-07-09/ (we-do-not-destroy); git fsck clean afterward. WHY IT MATTERS: if that server was ever reachable by others, the entire git history (and any secrets in it) was browsable. Operator should decide: (a) identify what served that path in January (python http.server? node serve?), (b) whether exposure was local-only, (c) whether any secrets in repo history warrant rotation. Marathon continued; no action taken beyond archiving.
